items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I used to admire Pico, too.

ctx.x: How many pieces would the bands have? Only six… It wouldn't be but six…

About six. That's all they used to do. I guess they used a banjo, huh? Used to use a banjo. They never used no piano in an old Dixie Ladd band. You're never singing that. What about you? Always a banjo. Guitar ever? Would they ever have a guitar player? Ghetto? Not that I remember. Let me check a little of this. See, I was wondering about some of the clarinet players that you admired out there. Well, I admired Big I, Lou, and Lorenzo Tio. I used to admire Pico, too. Well, do you think you'd play anything like…
Who were some of the people that you liked to listen to on records?
